entities.what: Row of short vertical slats under a rail in front of the 正店's east door beside the 香□ lamp-box, probably the same kind of barrier fence as at the west door.

entities.vis: part: heads of the crowd in front

entities.name: 彩楼欢门 (flowered scaffold gateway) of 孙羊正店
entities.what: The flowered scaffold gateway across the whole front of 孙羊正店: lashed poles (the west corner pole round and bound with rope lashings) rise from the street front past the ground-floor eave to the upper storey's eave, their tops tied with flower bunches, sprays and streamers; between them a lattice of cross-bars and diagonal braces forms a broad shallow V across the middle, hung with flowers and red streamers, and on its east side parallel bars run back toward the building. Lanterns: round 栀子灯 with cross-pattern frames on posts at the doors and one high in the middle, and a cube lantern above the 正店 box. At its feet stand the lamp-boxes 正店, 孫□ and 香□ (see note).

V-braces: (4600,600) down to (4800,690) and (5170,600) down to (4980,690). Lanterns: round at (4655,735) and (5105,745), each on a post (4645-4660 and 5075-5085, v ~760-900), round at (4845,655) on the scaffold, cube at (4525,725). Lamp-boxes (box with a small cap, standing on the ground at the doors: tile agents' props): 正店 4482-4553, v 790-900 (both characters clear); 孫□ 4650-4695, v 795-880 (孫 clear, the second hidden by heads; 羊 per sections.md); 香□ 5130-5195, v 790-900 (香 clear, the second hidden by a headdress; 醪 per sections.md). entities.name: slatted railing in front of the 正店 west door

entities.vis: part: a seated man in front of its west half
entities.note: Slats 4412-4565 from the top rail (v ~885-890; a second rail at ~905) down to v ~1000-1003. SCALE CUES: ~115 px tall; slats ~6-8 px apart. Gap 4565-4610 (a man stands in it). Stands ~1.9 m in front of the 正店's column line (est v 905).

entities.name: pole scaffold (small 彩楼) on the incense shop's east front
entities.what: A decorated scaffold of tall thin poles with spear-like finials along the incense shop's east front at its south-east corner, on the cross street: the poles rise past the shop's east eave and are tied by a lattice of cross-bars running back along the eave, hung with small ornaments (tassels or goods); a small 彩楼 like the 正店's, the 劉家 signboard standing just north-east of it.
entities.vis: part: the poles' lower parts are hidden behind the lean-to and the shop front; their feet are estimated
entities.note: Poles at u ~2895 (top v ~340), ~2930-2960, ~2985-2990 (top ~260), ~3045 (top ~220), ~3100 (top ~220), ~3117 (top ~260); lattice cross-bars along the east eave from about (2880,560) up to (3110,300). entities.name: square well (方井) with its 田-shaped cover
entities.what: The square well on the street's north margin at the west end of the section: a low wooden curb with a 田-shaped plank cover (a cross of bars dividing the opening into four, water strokes in the openings), set in the middle of a wide plank platform whose boards run east-west; men draw water at it with ropes, and tall hooped wooden buckets stand on the platform's west end.
entities.vis: part: west end of the platform behind the buckets
entities.src: 名画记 47 方井 (2110); 余辉: 深井汲水
entities.note: Base = the curb/cover. Curb front edge v ~955 (2000-2175), back edge v ~880 (2030-2205); cross bars at v ~915 and u ~2100-2110. PLATFORM (part of this structure, around the curb): back edge v ~855 from ~1995 (behind the buckets) to 2282; front edge v ~997 from ~1955 to 2240; east side (2240,998)->(2282,858). Its boards show 6-8 px of thickness at the front and the curb stands ~10-15 px proud of them: both low, well under knee height. entities.name: low fence among the bamboo (top left)
entities.what: Low fence of horizontal boards among the bamboo groves at the top-left of the section, in front of the far house S6.bld.far_house_1859.
entities.vis: part: among bamboo leaves
entities.note: Horizontal strokes 2000-2120, v 180-240, with a small round object at (2110,195). Could be the top of a low shed instead.

entities.name: cross street at the crossroads (running north)
entities.what: The street that leaves the main street northward at the crossroads, between the incense shop's open east front (its west side) and the corner shop's long west side (its east side); two four-mule wagons swing round the corner on it and a porter with baskets crosses it. It runs straight back up the silk and ends at the top street, in front of the cloth shop and the 杨家 clinic.
entities.vis: part: its east side's foot hidden behind the corner shop's roof
entities.note: Both sides are receding lines (the incense shop's east eave, slope -1.04, and the corner shop's west eave and ridge, -0.91 / -1.14), so it runs due north. Its walls' feet are hidden: edge_w = the incense shop's east wall (est 240 px below its east eave, the eave height measured on the corner shop's front); edge_e = the corner shop's west wall (est 265 px below its west eave). About 11.5 m wide (820 px of u at the mouth). The centre starts on the main street's centre line (2970,1178) and is drawn along the receding direction (dx ~52). It meets the main street's north edge between (2908,790) and (3725,865). South of the main street there is no built edge: the ground between the 解 building and the inn's west wing is an open square running out over the silk's edge, so the street may continue south across it, but nothing marks it. North: it ends at the top street (S6.road.top_2814), across which the cloth shop and the clinic front it (their post feet v 180-197); it leaves the silk only through that street. Tables and a lattice cabinet under the incense shop's lean-to stand on its west margin (3200-3330).

entities.name: top street (behind the incense shop, in front of the cloth shop)
entities.what: An east-west street at the very top of the silk, where the cross street ends: people and a handcart with a mule behind the incense shop's north gable, and the cloth shop and the 杨家 clinic fronting it on its north side; its west part runs behind the incense compound and out of the silk at the top-left.
entities.vis: part: mostly behind the compound and corner shop roofs; north margin cut by the silk
entities.note: Ground is seen at (3050-3250, v 80-165) behind the incense shop's north gable (two men at a bench or rail, a man with a load) and around the cart at 3260-3420, v 30-160. edge_n: the cloth shop's and clinic's post feet (v 180-197); west of the cloth shop's west end the ground reaches higher (v ~80) and the silk's top edge. edge_s: the north range of the incense compound (est v 286), the incense shop's north gable (est 3245,440), across the cross street's mouth, the corner shop's north end (est). Its east end is hidden behind the corner shop's roof and the big tree at 4150-4500; its course beyond is unknown.

entities.name: main street (inside the gate, through the crossroads)
entities.what: The town's main east-west street, continuing S5's road west from the wine depot: past the front of 孙羊正店 (its 彩楼欢门, lamp-boxes and slatted railings; sedans and riders in the street), the butcher's shop and the corner shop with the storyteller's crowd, across the mouth of the cross street at the crossroads, past the incense shop and the paper-horse stall to the square well on its north margin. On the north side the open ground stops at the shop fronts; on the south side at the roofs of the houses along the silk's bottom edge (the inn 久住王员外家 and its neighbours), except between the 解 building (u ~2050-2165) and the inn's west wing (u ~3160), where it opens into a wide square that runs out over the silk's bottom edge.
entities.vis: part: north margin behind crowds and stalls; south margin behind the south-side roofs
entities.note: No road edge is drawn as a line; edges are where the open ground stops. edge_n: the wall foot of the house behind the well (v ~800; the well stands on the street's north margin), the incense shop's south end (est v 790, behind the paper-horse stall's parasols, whose feet are at v ~850), its south-east corner (est 2908,790), then straight across the mouth of the cross street to the corner shop's south-west corner (est 3725,865), the corner shop, butcher's and 正店 fronts (column feet hidden by the crowd: est v 872, 880-885, 905; a gap of ~100 px between the butcher's and the 正店 at 4340-4441 holds only the slanting flag pole), and the wine depot's floor front (S5, est v 885-888). The 正店's slatted railings stand on the street ~95 px in front of its front (feet v ~1000). edge_s: the 解 building's north side and its slanted east board ((2045,1310) down to the silk's edge at (2165,1775); the building is S7's); open ground to the silk's edge (measured at v 1772-1785 along the section) from u ~2165 to the inn's west wing; the wing's west wall (est, along the receding direction from (3161,1775) to its NW corner (3501,1440)); then the north walls of the south-side houses, all hidden behind their own roofs, est at v 1440 to meet S5 (5600,1440). Nothing painted on the street stands lower than v ~1440 east of the wing (the boy at 3420,1395; trestles and a rider at 4800-5300, feet 1420-1440), so 1440 is the street's narrowest reading; the houses' real north walls may lie up to ~150 px lower (S5's house_5800 has porch posts with feet at v 1694-1758 under a top line at 1450): a question for the lead. Centre: through the traffic between the edges (walkers and porters at v 1100-1250 west of the crossroads; east of it midway between the fronts and v 1440, easing to S5's road end); its last point is exactly (5600,1250). The cross street S6.road.cross_2970 leaves it northward between u 2908 and 3725 (north edge).

entities.name: drawing water at the square well
entities.what: Three men draw water at the square well with its 田-shaped wooden cover: on its back beam one heaves a full bucket onto his shoulder while the next, facing us, draws on the rope that hangs into the shaft; at the east end a third, bent double, lifts a bucket out by its rope. A tall pole with a small box at its foot stands at the platform's east end.
entities.src: 名画记: 方井 (pin 47, ≈2110); 余辉: 深井汲水
entities.note: All three men stand east of the seam at u 2000. Three wooden buckets west of the cover (the lidded one at base ≈ (1990, 928), others ≈ (1950, 920) and (1922, 995)) are S7's and are not listed.

entities.name: men talking in front of the paper stall
entities.what: In front of the paper stall's west end three men in long robes stand together talking (one facing us, one with his back to us, one tall and dark-robed facing west); beside them a man in a tall black cap looks up at them with a hand at his chin, and a boy in a short jacket stands by him.
entities.note: Whether the robed men are the stall's customers is not clear; the one customer clearly at the stall stands at its east end (foot ~ (2605, 1078), t2).

entities.name: the paper-horse stall
entities.what: Under three big dark umbrellas a long table sells paper offerings for burning (paper figures, a tiered paper tower, a tray of small paper goods); the keeper stands behind its east end. A customer with a dark bundle stands at its east end (t2).
entities.src: sections.md S6: 列售纸码 (paper-horse stall under umbrellas, ≈2250–2600)
entities.note: Only t1's members are listed. The customer in front of the table's east end (foot ~ (2605, 1078)) and the man in grey facing us beside him (foot ~ (2640, 1037)) are t2's.

entities.name: the ring round the 解 sign
entities.what: Under a flat mat awning beside the tall 解 signboard, young men sit and stand in a ring round a pale-robed man seated on a bench with his back to us: a hooded old man and two smiling young men face him from the back, listeners sit at his west and east, men stand behind and beside them, a child stands at the bench's end, and a man with folded arms watches from the north-east.
entities.src: 名画记: "解"字招牌 (pin 45, ≈2070); 余辉: 考前求解
entities.note: 12 figures in the ring itself (ring members all at u >= 2030, none west of the seam). Which figure is 余辉's old fortune-teller is ambiguous: the pale-robed man on the bench (the ring faces him) or the hooded old man at the back.

entities.name: the rider and his donkey
entities.what: A young man rides a dark donkey away north-west into the crowd at the ring's south-east edge: a man in a pale robe holds its head, a groom in a short jacket walks at its shoulder with his back to us, and a boy in a dark robe watches at its rump.
entities.note: the grooms' roles are read from their poses; the boy may only be an onlooker.

entities.name: three robed men, one pointing east
entities.what: Three men in long robes stand talking in the open street south-east of the ring: one points east with his arm outstretched while one faces us and one stands with his back to us.

entities.name: two porters passing
entities.what: Two porters with shoulder poles pass each other in the open street: one in a dark cap walks west under two big round baskets, the other, with a top-knot, walks east just behind him with a tall cylindrical basket on his pole.

entities.name: crowd round the umbrellas east of the paper-horse stall
entities.what: A dense crowd stands under and in front of the big umbrellas in front of the shed: at the west end a man in a dark coat hands something to a round-faced man while a man in a kerchief watches; further east most stand with their backs to us facing the shed under the east umbrella, and a child clings to a tall man in a dark robe.
entities.note: Only t2 members listed. The paper-horse stall, its umbrellas (the west umbrella's pole stands at u ~2595) and its seller are t1's.

entities.name: two robed men talking at the incense shop corner
entities.what: Two men in long robes stand face to face in conversation at the west corner of the incense shop's front.

entities.name: customers at the tray vendor
entities.what: A vendor with a long tray stands facing the street; a man in a white jacket holding a folding stand and a man with folded arms stand before him, with a small child between them.

entities.name: two men with a lattice frame on the back street
entities.what: Two men on the back street beyond the incense shop's roof handle a long lattice frame between them.

entities.name: man carrying a child
entities.what: A man walks west through the street with a small child on his back.

entities.name: garment shown to a monk
entities.what: A man holds up a long garment for a smiling monk and a man in a dark robe to look at.

entities.name: the donkey cart with two wine casks
entities.what: A heavy cart with two wine casks is drawn east by two donkeys, a carter at the front with the whip, a young man steadying its rear.
entities.src: sections.md: a donkey cart with two wine casks ≈ 2700–3250

entities.name: stall under two umbrellas at the lower edge
entities.what: A small stall under two big umbrellas at the bottom edge, between the wine cart and the bare tree: a signboard stands by the near umbrella, one man sits by the pole and another sits half hidden behind the tree.

entities.name: the wheelbarrow at the top of the street
entities.what: A man leans over a parked wheelbarrow at the top of the silk, with a second figure standing behind it, cut off by the silk's edge.

entities.name: the cloth shop's front
entities.what: The cloth shop (王家羅明匹帛鋪) at the top of the cross street: its signboard stands on the street, and under the eave two counter tables with a bench, where customers sit and stand.
entities.src: sections.md: 王家罗明匹帛铺

entities.name: the big wagon turning the corner
entities.what: A big 太平車 wagon drawn by four mules swings out of the cross street onto the main street, heading west: a burly carter steers at the shafts with a long whip, a young man rides on the front of the bed and another man walks beside the wheel.
entities.src: sections.md: two four-mule wagons swinging round the corner
entities.note: Four mules painted in this team.

entities.name: the second wagon's team
entities.what: A carter walks behind a team of four mules heading east at the corner; their traces run back under the corner shed's roof to a wagon hidden behind it.
entities.src: sections.md: two four-mule wagons swinging round the corner

entities.name: the man with the fan and his servant boy
entities.what: A man shields his face with a round fan (便面) as he walks west, his servant boy beside him carrying a bundle.
entities.src: 名画记: 便面 (pin 43)

entities.name: the rider and his groom
entities.what: A rider on a dark horse heads up the street away from the viewer, his groom walking at the horse's side with a whip.
entities.src: brief: a rider in the middle of the street (≈ 3300–3450)

entities.name: the scholars and their servants
entities.what: Two scholars in white robes stand talking; a young servant holding a long case reaches out toward them, and another man carries a long box on his shoulder (read as scholars on their way to the exams with their luggage).
entities.src: 名画记: 赶考士人 (pin 44)
entities.note: Which servant goes with which scholar is not painted.

entities.name: two men greeting
entities.what: Two men meet in the street: one in a dark robe bows with joined hands to a bearded man, who returns the greeting.

entities.name: the box porter and a customer
entities.what: A porter carries two boxes on a shoulder pole eastward; a man in a dark robe reaches toward the west box as it passes.

entities.name: barrow pushed past the incense shop
entities.what: A man in a broad hat stands between the handles of a barrow heaped with roped dark bundles at the incense shop's corner and pushes it east toward the crossroads.

entities.name: two men talking on the top street
entities.what: On the street at the top of the silk, behind the butcher shop's roof, a man in a long dark robe and black hat faces a man in a pale short jacket; they stand close together as if greeting or talking.

entities.name: the 孫羊店 meat shop
entities.what: Under the eave of the 孫羊店 building, the open shop front sells pork: a long counter with a dark pot on it, a side of pork hanging above, and at the east end a thick chopping block with big pieces of pork where the butcher leans over his work; the shop's banner 孫羊店 hangs from the eave east of it. The storyteller's crowd stands in front of the counter.
entities.src: sections.md: the 孙羊店 butcher's flag

entities.name: the storyteller and his listeners (闹市说书)
entities.what: A crowd stands in a ring on the street in front of the 孫羊店 meat counter listening to a bearded storyteller who faces out of the ring toward the viewer: most listeners turn their backs to us, two men stand beside him facing into the ring, a child stands at its front edge. Nine members are east of u 3800 (listed here); about ten more stand west of u 3800 (tile t3), about 19 people in all.
entities.src: 名画记: 闹市说书 (pin 39, 3840); sections.md: the storyteller with 17-18 listeners (≈ 3600-4200)
entities.note: Members west of u 3800 (t3's), read from the strokes: man in a dark robe and hat (head 3625,740; feet ~3638,982); man holding a dark fan (head 3675,730); man by the shop post (head 3742,704); a face between them (3725,789); dark heads at (3679,802), (3705,832), (3787,822); a pale-jacketed man with a belt seen from behind (head ~3745,842; feet ~3770,1029); dark-robed and pale-robed backs at u ~3690 and ~3655 (feet ~v 1015-1022).

entities.name: the tray stall with the high seat
entities.what: A street stall in front of the 孫羊店 building, east of the storyteller's ring: an oval tray of goods on a crossed-leg stand with a basket under it; a man on a high chair sits behind it with a young man beside him, a man bends over the tray from its east end, and a man holding a small jar stands at its west end; a slanted dotted board on a frame stands behind its west end.

entities.name: the parasol stall
entities.what: A stall under a big tilted parasol at the west end of 孫羊正店's street front: two oval trays of goods on folding stands with a tub of upright sticks between them and a net bag hanging under the parasol. No seller is drawn at it; the seated man at the 正店's door (east of u 4400, tile t5) may keep it.

entities.name: a seated man and a crouching man
entities.what: On the south side of the street west of the fan man, a man in a square black cap sits facing the viewer while a man in a pale jacket crouches in front of him, bent over something in his hands.

entities.name: two men under a dark umbrella with a stack of boxes
entities.what: On the south side of the street, a youth and a round-faced man stand under one wide dark umbrella with a pole between them at shoulder height and a stack of flat boxes below it; a man looks up beside the boxes. They may be carrying the boxes on the pole.
entities.note: Reading uncertain (faded, partly hidden by the inn's roof).

entities.name: the scholar studying upstairs
entities.what: In the upper storey of the inn 久住王員外家, a young scholar sits at the window with his hand to his chin beside a table with a lamp and books (士子苦读).
entities.src: 名画记: 久住王员外家 (pin 42); sections.md: 士子苦读

entities.name: the west sedan and its people
entities.what: The west sedan is carried east past the 正店's door: two bearers at its front poles, a woman (the matchmaker) looking out of its window, an attendant walking beside its front. Its rear bearer(s) at u ~4150-4280 are in the next tile west and not listed here.
entities.vis: full
entities.src: sections.md S6: two matchmakers' sedans stop at 孙羊正店's door (≈ 4300–4850)

entities.name: the east sedan and its bearers
entities.what: The east sedan is carried east along the middle of the street by four bearers, two at each end of its poles.
entities.vis: full

entities.name: talk at the big basket by the 正店 door
entities.what: At the 正店's door, by the big basket: a man sits on a stool beside it, a man behind it talks to the old man in the tall black hat, and a young man in white and a boy stand by listening.
entities.vis: full
entities.src: sections.md S6: 孙羊正店 (pin 36, 孙羊家正店 ≈ 4530), setting

entities.name: two men greeting before the shop front
entities.what: Two men greet each other in front of the 正店's shop front: the stout man in the dark robe bows with joined hands to the man who has his back to us.
entities.vis: full
entities.src: sections.md S6: 孙羊正店 (pin 36, 孙羊家正店 ≈ 4530), setting

entities.name: man with a child on his shoulders

entities.name: the second big basket and the youth behind it
entities.what: A youth with a long stick stands behind the second big basket east of the door, perhaps selling from it.
entities.vis: full

entities.name: drinkers at a table in the 正店's east upper room
entities.what: Two men at a table in the open upper room of 孙羊正店's east part: one stands at its west end, the other sits leaning over the dishes; a wine ewer stands between them.
entities.src: sections.md S6: 孙羊正店
entities.note: This room (eave v ≈ 275, u 5410-5640) is where S5.bld.back_hall_5790 meets the 正店's upper storey.

entities.name: the sack cart, its team and carters
entities.what: A big two-wheeled cart piled with roped sacks being drawn west past 孙羊正店 by a team of donkeys on long slack traces: two donkeys at the cart's front, a pale one beyond, a dark lead donkey led by a man in white at the 正店's door; carters stand at the front and walk beside the wheel, and a pack donkey with lowered head waits by the wine depot.
entities.src: sections.md S5/S6: the second group of taxpayers (pack train)
entities.note: The cart's pusher is S5.fig.cart_pusher_5727 (S5). S5's pack-train group S5.grp.pack_train (pack donkey 5660, box pack 5780, pack handler 5837, man with bag 5892) continues here: this group is its west half. The door donkey and its leader are included as the team's lead (low: no trace from them to the cart is clear).

entities.name: rider with a groom behind the south-side roofs
entities.what: A man in a light robe rides a dark horse west along the street's south edge, a groom walking at the horse's head; seen only above the ridge of the south-side houses.
